from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class CompanyReport(BaseModel):
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock code or securities code of the company, if available")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The period of the financial report (e.g., 2025 Q1)")
    operating_cash_flow_net: Optional[float] = Field(description="Net cash flow from operating activities amount (positive/negative)")
    cash_paid_for_fixed_assets: Optional[float] = Field(description="Cash paid for construction of fixed assets, intangible assets and other long-term assets (positive/negative)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_reports: List[CompanyReport]
